Summary: Updates target ABI argument-extension classification so ARM, AArch64, X86-32, and RISC-V pass the LLVM IR type produced by CGT.ConvertType(Ty) into ABIArgInfo extension metadata. On RISC-V, RISCVABIInfo::extendType now accepts an optional coercion type and forwards it to getSignExtend/getExtend. The stated purpose is correcting code generation for transparent_union function parameters.
Changed symbols: RISCVABIInfo::extendType; RISCVABIInfo::classifyArgumentType; AArch64ABIInfo::classifyArgumentType; X86_32ABIInfo::classifyArgumentType; ARMABIInfo::classifyArgumentType; ABIArgInfo::getExtend; ABIArgInfo::getExtendInReg; ABIArgInfo::getSignExtend
Behavioral change: ABI extension argument classifications now carry an explicit LLVM coercion type derived from CGT.ConvertType(Ty), rather than relying only on the QualType.; RISC-V extension classification propagates the supplied coercion type through both sign-extension and generic extension ABIArgInfo creation.; The affected behavior is target calling-convention lowering for extendable arguments, particularly the transparent_union parameter case named by the commit.

Summary: This is predominantly an NFC-style range-for refactoring across Clang CodeGen. The retrieved changes replace index- and iterator-based traversal with range-based traversal in Microsoft vtable handling, AArch64 SVE/SME builtin operand rewriting, record-layout packing checks, label rescoping, and X86 ABI argument inspection.

Behavioral change: The loop rewrites preserve traversal order and the original container element access patterns.; The SVE/SME operand loops retain mutation semantics by iterating as Value *& and assigning the predicate-cast result back to each operand.; rescopeLabels still checks every LabelDecl in Labels and retrieves the corresponding JumpDest from CGF.LabelMap; only iterator spelling changed.; No retrieved hunk changes LLVM IR loop structure, ScalarEvolution reasoning, SCEVExpander, or loop-exit-value rewriting.

top_candidates.subject: [clang][CodeGen] Omit pre-opt link when post-opt is link requested (#85672)
top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This change alters when Clang links requested bitcode modules: when LinkBitcodePostopt is enabled, it skips pre-optimization linking and instead links through LinkInModulesPass after optimization. It also removes module reloading support and marks the post-optimization linking pass as invalidating analyses after it links modules.
Changed symbols: LinkInModulesPass::run; BackendConsumer::ReloadModules; BackendConsumer::HandleTranslationUnit; CodeGenAction::ExecuteAction; EmitAssemblyHelper::RunOptimizationPipeline; BackendConsumer::LinkInModules
Behavioral change: Skips pre-optimization LinkInModules calls in HandleTranslationUnit and ExecuteAction when CodeGenOpts.LinkBitcodePostopt is enabled.; Uses CodeGenOpts.LinkBitcodePostopt rather than the removed relink-builtin-bitcode-postop command-line option to select post-optimization bitcode linking.; Removes ReloadModules and stops reloading bitcode modules inside LinkInModulesPass::run.; Returns PreservedAnalyses::none() after post-optimization module linking, correctly declaring that linking invalidates analyses.
Assertion or trace link: No matching isKnownSentinel, SCEVExpander, or rewriteLoopExitValues assertion/trace term appears in the retrieved hunks.; Crash-signal artifact is unavailable and reachability is reported as text-unreachable.
Reproducer link: The reported reproducer is an ordinary reduced C asm-goto pointer-loop case; the retrieved changes affect behavior only around requested bitcode-module linking and the LinkBitcodePostopt option.; No retrieved evidence shows that the reproducer uses linked bitcode or post-optimization linking.
Pass or subsystem link: Clang CodeGen bitcode linking; LLVM new-pass-manager analysis preservation; No retrieved touch to ScalarEvolution, SCEVExpander, loop-exit rewriting, asm-goto lowering, or loop canonicalization
Causal explanation: The explicit analysis invalidation after module linking is optimizer-adjacent and avoids running subsequent passes with analyses preserved across a module mutation. However, this pass is relevant only when post-optimization bitcode linking is requested, and the evidence does not place the asm-goto reproducer in that configuration. It does not directly modify the IR generated for asm goto or the SCEV loop-exit path.

top_candidates.subject: Revert "[codegen] Emit missing cleanups for stmt-expr and coro suspensions" and related commits (#88884)
top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This revert backs out cleanup-deactivation and deferred-cleanup changes in Clang CodeGen. The visible changes restore older manual cleanup tracking in array initialization and aggregate/lambda emission, restore an explicit EH cleanup path for lifetime-extended destruction, and remove special insertion-point handling used while deactivating normal cleanups.
Changed symbols: CodeGenFunction::EmitNewArrayInitializer; CodeGenFunction::EmitCallArg; CodeGenFunction::pushLifetimeExtendedDestroy; AggExprEmitter::VisitLambdaExpr; AggExprEmitter::EmitArrayInit; CodeGenFunction::PopCleanupBlock; CodeGenFunction::CleanupDeactivationScope
Behavioral change: Replaces CleanupDeactivationScope/deferred-deactivation tracking with explicit EHScopeStack cleanup iterators and cleanup-dominator instructions in several aggregate and new-array initialization paths.; Restores pushing a separate EH-only DestroyObject cleanup for lifetime-extended destruction when the cleanup kind includes EHCleanup.; Removes PopCleanupBlock logic that temporarily clears the builder insertion point when deactivating a normal cleanup or when asynchronous EH does not apply.; Changes the visible EmitCallArg cleanup-state instruction from a flag load back to CreateUnreachable as part of the revert.
Assertion or trace link: No matching isKnownSentinel, SCEVExpander, or rewriteLoopExitValues assertion/trace term appears in the retrieved hunks.; Crash-signal artifact is unavailable and reachability is reported as text-unreachable.
Reproducer link: The issue involves C asm goto outputs and a pointer loop, whereas the retrieved changes concern C++ cleanups, array initialization, lambda initialization, statement-expression/coroutine cleanup behavior, and EH control flow.; No retrieved hunk names or handles asm goto directly.
Pass or subsystem link: Clang CodeGen cleanup/EH lowering; No retrieved touch to LLVM ScalarEvolution, SCEVExpander, loop-exit rewriting, or loop canonicalization
Causal explanation: Cleanup lowering can change generated CFG and therefore can indirectly affect later optimizations, and the EmitCallArg change is nominally near code used to form call-like operands. However, the retrieved evidence confines the substantive work to cleanup/EH handling and does not connect it to inline asm-goto lowering, pointer-loop IR, or the failing SCEV path. The candidate is therefore only a weak indirect possibility.
Causal confidence: 0.06

Summary: Changes Clang C++ ABI code generation so vtable-, VTT-, RTTI-, and virtual-function-related global pointer types use CodeGenModule::GlobalsInt8PtrTy rather than the generic Int8PtrTy or newly constructed unqualified pointer types. top_candidates.subject: [clang][CodeGen] Fix GPU-specific attributes being dropped by bitcode linking
top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This Clang CodeGen commit prevents default function-definition attribute merging from overwriting target-feature attributes already present on functions imported through bitcode linking. It adds a SetTargetFeatures control to GetCPUAndFeaturesAttributes and disables target-feature insertion specifically from mergeDefaultFunctionDefinitionAttributes; the accompanying tests cover AMDGPU/CUDA device-library bitcode with GPU-specific target attributes.
Changed symbols: CodeGenModule::mergeDefaultFunctionDefinitionAttributes; CodeGenModule::GetCPUAndFeaturesAttributes; CodeGenModule
Behavioral change: GetCPUAndFeaturesAttributes can now omit target-feature attributes while still collecting other CPU and feature-related attributes.; mergeDefaultFunctionDefinitionAttributes invokes GetCPUAndFeaturesAttributes with AddTargetFeatures disabled, preserving target features already carried by linked-in bitcode functions.; The added tests verify preservation of AMDGPU +gfx11-insts target features and retain checks for AMDGPU denormal-mode and target-CPU attributes.

+// Verify the behavior of the +gfxN-insts in the way that
+// rocm-device-libs should be built with. e.g. If the device libraries has a function
+// with "+gfx11-insts", that attribute should still be present after linking and not

+
+// This is important because at this time, many device-libs functions that are only
+// available on some GPUs put an attribute such as "+gfx11-insts" so that
+// AMDGPURemoveIncompatibleFunctions can detect & remove them if needed.
+
+// Build the fake device library in the way rocm-device-libs should be built.
+//
+// RUN: %clang_cc1 -x cl -triple amdgcn-amd-amdhsa\
+// RUN:   -mcode-object-version=none -emit-llvm-bc \
+// RUN:   %S/Inputs/ocml-sample-target-attrs.cl -o %t.bc
+

+// RUN:   -mlink-builtin-bitcode %t.bc \

Summary: This commit changes Clang OpenCL/SPIR-V type lowering so target code-generation hooks can return SPIR-V target-extension types for OpenCL pipes, images, samplers, events, queues, reserve IDs, and Intel AVC extension types. Summary: Fixes C++ constructor/destructor calling-convention arrangement by passing GlobalDecl, including the constructor/destructor variant, into C++ ABI this-argument-type selection. Summary: Adds and propagates known-non-null state through Clang CodeGen Address and LValue construction and pointer replacement operations. Stack allocations, return-value addresses, and certain derived addresses are marked known non-null, while thread-local-address rewrites explicitly lose that guarantee.
Changed symbols: Address; CodeGenFunction::CreateTempAllocaWithoutCast; CodeGenFunction::CreateTempAlloca; CodeGenFunction::CreateMemTemp; CodeGenFunction::EmitLoadOfScalar; CodeGenFunction::EmitStoreOfScalar; CodeGenFunction::EmitDeclRefLValue; CodeGenFunction::StartFunction
Behavioral change: Addresses derived from allocas, memory temporaries, and indirect return storage are recorded as KnownNonNull.; Address::withPointer uses explicitly preserve known non-nullness for a selected OpenMP PHI and explicitly clear it after CreateThreadLocalAddress transformations.; The change establishes a CodeGen pointer-validity invariant that may influence later uses of Address/LValue non-null information, although the retrieved hunks do not show a direct IR attribute emission or optimizer consumer.
Assertion or trace link: No retrieved hunk mentions isKnownSentinel, SCEVExpander, ScalarEvolution, or rewriteLoopExitValues.; Crash-signal reachability is reported as text-unreachable, and no assertion contract was available.
Reproducer link: The issue includes a pointer loop, and this commit broadly changes CodeGen's representation of pointer non-nullness.; No retrieved hunk handles asm goto or asm-goto outputs, and no test for the reported C reproducer or optimizer failure is shown.
Pass or subsystem link: Clang CodeGen Address/LValue pointer-property tracking; OpenMP CodeGen at one propagation site; Not an LLVM ScalarEvolution, SCEVExpander, or loop-exit-rewriting change
Causal explanation: This is the strongest of the three candidates only in the generic sense that it changes pointer-related CodeGen invariants and the failure involves a pointer loop; changed IR facts could in principle affect subsequent optimization. The retrieved evidence does not establish that the non-null flag reaches the generated IR for the reproducer, changes asm-goto CFG semantics, or is consumed by ScalarEvolution. steps.subject: [Clang] support for outputs along indirect edges of asm goto

evidence: Directly changes lowering of asm goto output operands, the distinctive reproducer feature.
Introduces split callbr indirect-edge blocks, result extracts, and edge-local stores that materially change CFG, dominance, and loop exit-value definitions seen by -O1 optimizers.
features: asm-goto-outputs, callbr, clang-codegen, critical-edge-splitting, loop-cfg-shape, path:clang/docs
selection.diff_summary:
Summary: This commit changes Clang's lowering of GNU asm goto statements with output operands. CodeGenFunction::EmitAsmStmt now retains the generated CallBrInst, splits every indirect callbr destination when outputs exist, extracts callbr results in the new split blocks, and emits the asm-output stores separately on each indirect edge as well as on the fallthrough path.
Changed symbols: CodeGenFunction::EmitAsmStmt; EmitAsmStores; llvm::CallBrInst; CBRRegResults; clang/test/CodeGen/asm-goto.c; clang/test/CodeGen/asm-goto2.c
Behavioral change: asm goto output values are now materialized on indirect-label paths, rather than only through the ordinary fallthrough handling.; Each indirect callbr destination is replaced with a synthesized '.split' block when output registers exist.; The synthesized block extracts scalar or aggregate callbr results and emits stores for the asm outputs before branching to the original label.; The emitted IR CFG and definitions reaching asm-goto labels change materially, including the addition of split predecessor blocks and output stores on indirect edges.
Assertion or trace link: The supplied crash anchors mention SCEVExpander, isKnownSentinel, and rewriteLoopExitValues, but no assertion artifact or direct stack-trace contact is available.; This commit has no retrieved hunk in ScalarEvolution, SCEVExpander, or loop-exit rewriting.
Reproducer link: The issue reproducer is described as using asm goto outputs and a pointer loop.; This commit directly implements asm goto outputs along indirect edges, the distinctive language/codegen feature named in the issue.; The added tests specifically check callbr output handling on indirect destinations, including generated '.split' blocks and stores on those paths.
Pass or subsystem link: Clang CodeGen; LLVM IR callbr CFG construction; Downstream optimizer loop analysis and loop-exit-value rewriting
Causal explanation: This is a strong candidate because it changes the IR shape and value-definition placement for precisely the asm goto output paths implicated by the reproducer. In particular, splitting indirect destinations and inserting output stores can alter loop predecessor structure, dominance, and values seen by optimization at -O1; those altered CFG/value relationships could expose a later SCEVExpander or rewriteLoopExitValues failure in a pointer loop. @@ -1261,26 +1243 @@ void LowerTypeTestsModule::createJumpTableEntry(
-    if (!CanUseThumbBWJumpTable) {
-      // In Armv6-M, this sequence will generate a branch without corrupting
-      // any registers. We use two stack words; in the second, we construct the
-      // address we'll pop into pc, and the first is used to save and restore
-      // r0 which we use as a temporary register.
-      //
-      // To support position-independent use cases, the offset of the target
-      // function is stored as a relative offset (which will expand into an
-      // R_ARM_REL32 relocation in ELF, and presumably the equivalent in other
-      // object file types), and added to pc after we load it. (The alternative
-      // B.W is automatically pc-relative.)
-      //
-      // There are five 16-bit Thumb instructions here, so the .balign 4 adds a
-      // sixth halfword of padding, and then the offset consumes a further 4
-      // bytes, for a total of 16, which is very convenient since entries in
-      // this jump table need to have power-of-two size.
-      AsmOS << "push {r0,r1}\n"
-            << "ldr r0, 1f\n"
-            << "0: add r0, r0, pc\n"
-            << "str r0, [sp, #4]\n"
-            << "pop {r0,pc}\n"
-            << ".balign 4\n"
-            << "1: .word $" << ArgIndex << " - (0b + 4)\n";
-    } else {
-      AsmOS << "b.w $" << ArgIndex << "\n";
-    }
+    AsmOS << "b.w $" << ArgIndex << "\n";

steps.subject: [Dominators] check indirect branches of callbr

evidence: Directly changes CallBrInst dominance and InstCombine handling for asm-goto indirect edges.
Callbr CFG and SSA changes can alter the loop structure consumed later by loop-exit rewriting and ScalarEvolution, though no direct SCEV change is present.
features: asm-goto-outputs, callbr, dominance-and-instcombine, meta:core-llvm, path:llvm/include/llvm/IR, path:llvm/lib/IR/Dominators.cpp
selection.diff_summary:
Summary: This commit removes ConstExpr-cast call rewriting support for CallBrInst in InstCombine and explicitly asserts that transformConstExprCastCall is not called on a callbr. The prior special handling treated callbr partly like invoke, including selecting its default destination as a PHI-unsupported block and rebuilding it with CreateCallBr; the new code limits the transformation to call and invoke because a callbr has multiple control-flow exits and no single insertion point after its definition.
Changed symbols: InstCombinerImpl::visitCallBase; InstCombinerImpl::transformConstExprCastCall; CallBrInst; IRBuilderBase::CreateCallBr
Behavioral change: InstCombine no longer rewrites constant-expression casts around CallBrInst operands by rebuilding the callbr.; CallBrInst is no longer treated as having an invoke-like single continuation/default-destination insertion model for this transformation.; In assertion-enabled builds, entering transformConstExprCastCall with a CallBrInst now triggers an assertion that callbr has no single post-definition insertion point.
Assertion or trace link: No crash assertion artifact is available.; The retrieved changes do not mention isKnownSentinel, SCEVExpander, ScalarEvolution, or rewriteLoopExitValues.; The added assertion is specific to InstCombine's transformConstExprCastCall handling of CallBrInst, not the reported SCEVExpander path.
Reproducer link: asm goto is represented in LLVM IR by callbr-like control flow, so the commit operates on the instruction class directly relevant to asm-goto outputs.; The change can alter whether InstCombine rebuilds a callbr and therefore can alter the CFG/SSA form subsequently presented to later loop analyses.; No retrieved hunk demonstrates the reduced pointer-loop reproducer, a loop-exit rewrite, or a ScalarEvolution query.
Pass or subsystem link: InstCombine; LLVM IR CallBrInst/control-flow handling; Dominance-sensitive SSA/CFG transformation

A changed callbr CFG or SSA shape could indirectly affect later loop and ScalarEvolution processing. However, the available evidence contains no direct ScalarEvolution or loop-exit-rewrite modification and no stack/assertion evidence connecting this transformation to SCEVExpander, so the causal link remains indirect.

top_candidates.subject: [llvm][SelectionDAGBuilder] codegen callbr.landingpad intrinsic
top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This commit adjusts SelectionDAG callbr lowering support for the callbr.landingpad intrinsic. The visible functional change relaxes CopyToExportRegsIfNeeded's invariant so a CallBrInst may have no ordinary IR uses while still being assigned export registers, and it declares SelectionDAGBuilder::visitCallBrLandingPad. New llc tests exercise asm-goto/callbr outputs reaching indirect destinations on PowerPC, X86, and AArch64.
Changed symbols: SelectionDAGBuilder::CopyToExportRegsIfNeeded; SelectionDAGBuilder::visitCallBrLandingPad; CallBrInst
Behavioral change: Permits a CallBrInst to bypass the previous non-empty-use assertion in CopyToExportRegsIfNeeded, acknowledging that callbr output values may need virtual/export registers even when the CallBrInst itself has no conventional uses.; Adds SelectionDAGBuilder interface support for lowering llvm.callbr.landingpad calls.; Adds backend code-generation coverage for callbr output values on indirect asm-goto edges, including scalar and aggregate outputs.
Reproducer link: The new tests model asm-goto/callbr outputs on indirect destinations, matching the issue's asm goto outputs feature area.
Pass or subsystem link: LLVM SelectionDAG instruction selection; callbr/asm-goto backend lowering

diff --git a/llvm/lib/CodeGen/CallBrPrepare.cpp b/llvm/lib/CodeGen/CallBrPrepare.cpp
new file mode 100644
index 000000000000..4bec56c20eb2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/llvm/lib/CodeGen/CallBrPrepare.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,75 @@
+//===-- CallBrPrepare - Prepare callbr for code generation ----------------===//
+//
+// Part of the LLVM Project, under the Apache License v2.0 with LLVM Exceptions.
+// See https://llvm.org/LICENSE.txt for license information.
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
+//
+//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
+//
+// This pass lowers callbrs in LLVM IR in order to to assist SelectionDAG's
+// codegen.
+//
+// In particular, this pass assists in inserting register copies for the output
+// values of a callbr along the edges leading to the indirect target blocks.
+// Though the output SSA value is defined by the callbr instruction itself in
+// the IR representation, the value cannot be copied to the appropriate virtual
+// registers prior to jumping to an indirect label, since the jump occurs
+// within the user-provided assembly blob.
+//
+// Instead, those copies must occur separately at the beginning of each
+// indirect target. That requires that we create a separate SSA definition in
+// each of them (via llvm.callbr.landingpad), and may require splitting
+// critical edges so we have a location to place the intrinsic. Finally, we
+// remap users of the original callbr output SSA value to instead point to the
+// appropriate llvm.callbr.landingpad value.
+//
+// Ideally, this could be done inside SelectionDAG, or in the
+// MachineInstruction representation, without the use of an IR-level intrinsic.
+// But, within the current framework, it’s simpler to implement as an IR pass.
+// (If support for callbr in GlobalISel is implemented, it’s worth considering
+// whether this is still required.)
+//
+//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
+
+#include "llvm/CodeGen/Passes.h"
+#include "llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h"
+#include "llvm/IR/Function.h"
+#include "llvm/IR/Instructions.h"
+#include "llvm/InitializePasses.h"
+#include "llvm/Pass.h"
+
+using namespace llvm;
+
+#define DEBUG_TYPE "callbrprepare"
+
+namespace {
+
+class CallBrPrepare : public FunctionPass {
+public:
+  CallBrPrepare() : FunctionPass(ID) {}
+  static char ID;
+  void getAnalysisUsage(AnalysisUsage &AU) const override;
+  bool runOnFunction(Function &Fn) override;
+};
+
+} // end anonymous namespace
+
+char CallBrPrepare::ID = 0;
+INITIALIZE_PASS(CallBrPrepare, DEBUG_TYPE, "Prepare callbr", false, false)
+
+FunctionPass *llvm::createCallBrPass() { return new CallBrPrepare(); }
+
+void CallBrPrepare::getAnalysisUsage(AnalysisUsage &AU) const {
+  AU.setPreservesAll();
+}
+
+bool CallBrPrepare::runOnFunction(Function &Fn) {
+  for (BasicBlock &BB : Fn) {
+    auto *CBR = dyn_cast<CallBrInst>(BB.getTerminator());
+    if (!CBR)
+      continue;
+    // TODO: something interesting.
+    // https://discourse.llvm.org/t/rfc-syncing-asm-goto-with-outputs-with-gcc/65453/8
+  }
+  return false;
+}

top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This commit updates CallBrPrepare's handling of non-void callbr results, with the commit subject identifying SSAUpdater-based propagation of the intrinsic value. The added AArch64 tests cover callbr asm-output values across direct and indirect destinations, including diamonds, triangles, identical destinations, critical-edge splitting, PHI formation, and a self-looping callbr case.
Changed symbols: CallBrPrepare; CallBrPrepare::SplitCriticalEdges; CallBrPrepare::InsertIntrinsicCalls; FindCallBrs; dont_split4; dont_split5; split_me3; dont_split6
Behavioral change: CallBrPrepare now uses SSAUpdater for propagation of a callbr result used by the callbr.landingpad intrinsic, as stated by the commit subject.; The added tests require transformed indirect callbr paths to use llvm.callbr.landingpad values and to merge direct and indirect-path values through PHIs where control-flow splitting creates distinct reaching definitions.; The tests specifically exercise a loop whose callbr indirect destination returns to the loop header, requiring the loop PHI backedge to receive the landingpad-derived value after critical-edge splitting.
Assertion or trace link: asm goto; asm goto outputs; callbr; callbr.landingpad
Reproducer link: The new dont_split6 test has a self-looping callbr with an output tied through a loop PHI, which overlaps the issue's asm-goto-output and loop-control-flow characteristics.; The commit does not include the reported pointer-loop pattern or a Clang C reproducer.
Pass or subsystem link: llvm/lib/CodeGen/CallBrPrepare.cpp; LLVM CodeGen callbr preparation
Causal explanation: There is semantic overlap because asm goto outputs are represented as callbr results and the new tests include a loop-shaped callbr CFG. However, the retrieved implementation and tests concern late CodeGen preparation, while the reported crash anchors are ScalarEvolution, SCEVExpander, isKnownSentinel, and rewriteLoopExitValues in the optimizer. No retrieved hunk touches ScalarEvolution or loop-exit rewriting, and no crash-anchor reachability was found.
Causal confidence: 0.06
Build risk: Adds extensive AArch64 CodeGen/FileCheck coverage for callbr preparation, including loop and PHI cases.; The visible implementation hunk only adds llvm/ADT/iterator.h; the substantive SSAUpdater implementation change is indicated by the commit subject and post-change function context rather than a visible algorithmic diff hunk.; Coverage metadata reports 12 omitted hunks, so the retrieved patch is incomplete for implementation-level review.

causal_evidence.summary: This commit updates CallBrPrepare's handling of non-void callbr results, with the commit subject identifying SSAUpdater-based propagation of the intrinsic value. The added AArch64 tests cover callbr asm-output values across direct and indirect destinations, including diamonds, triangles, identical destinations, critical-edge splitting, PHI formation, and a self-looping callbr case.
behavioral_change: CallBrPrepare now uses SSAUpdater for propagation of a callbr result used by the callbr.landingpad intrinsic, as stated by the commit subject.

The added tests require transformed indirect callbr paths to use llvm.callbr.landingpad values and to merge direct and indirect-path values through PHIs where control-flow splitting creates distinct reaching definitions.

The tests specifically exercise a loop whose callbr indirect destination returns to the loop header, requiring the loop PHI backedge to receive the landingpad-derived value after critical-edge splitting.

reproducer: The new dont_split6 test has a self-looping callbr with an output tied through a loop PHI, which overlaps the issue's asm-goto-output and loop-control-flow characteristics.
The commit does not include the reported pointer-loop pattern or a Clang C reproducer.
issue_link.explanation: There is semantic overlap because asm goto outputs are represented as callbr results and the new tests include a loop-shaped callbr CFG. However, the retrieved implementation and tests concern late CodeGen preparation, while the reported crash anchors are ScalarEvolution, SCEVExpander, isKnownSentinel, and rewriteLoopExitValues in the optimizer. No retrieved hunk touches ScalarEvolution or loop-exit rewriting, and no crash-anchor reachability was found.

build_risk: Adds extensive AArch64 CodeGen/FileCheck coverage for callbr preparation, including loop and PHI cases.

The visible implementation hunk only adds llvm/ADT/iterator.h; the substantive SSAUpdater implementation change is indicated by the commit subject and post-change function context rather than a visible algorithmic diff hunk.
Coverage metadata reports 12 omitted hunks, so the retrieved patch is incomplete for implementation-level review.

top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This commit enables the existing CallBrPrepare pass in both the new and legacy instruction-selection preparation pipelines and updates MachineVerifier to accept allocatable live-ins in inlineasm-br indirect-target machine blocks. Pipeline tests are updated to require the new "Prepare callbr" stage.
Changed symbols: CodeGenPassBuilder<Derived>::addISelPrepare; TargetPassConfig::addISelPrepare; MachineVerifier::visitMachineBasicBlockBefore; CallBrPrepare; MachineBasicBlock::isInlineAsmBrIndirectTarget
Behavioral change: The new CodeGen pass-builder pipeline now adds CallBrPrepare during instruction-selection preparation.; The legacy TargetPassConfig pipeline now adds createCallBrPass during instruction-selection preparation.; MachineVerifier no longer rejects an allocatable live-in solely because a non-entry, non-landing-pad block is an inlineasm-br indirect target.; AArch64, PowerPC, and RISCV O0/O3 pipeline tests now expect the "Prepare callbr" stage.
Assertion or trace link: asm goto; callbr; inlineasm-br-indirect-target
Reproducer link: Enabling CallBrPrepare makes backend compilation of callbr/asm-goto output CFGs materially different, and the verifier adjustment confirms that indirect inline-asm destinations may carry live-in values.; There is no retrieved reproducer overlap with the issue's pointer loop, ScalarEvolution query, SCEVExpander expansion, or loop-exit-value rewrite.
Pass or subsystem link: LLVM CodeGen instruction-selection preparation pipeline; MachineVerifier; CallBrPrepare
Causal explanation: This commit can expose CallBrPrepare transformations for all applicable CodeGen pipelines and is therefore relevant to asm-goto output handling. But it adds the pass after the optimizer, at instruction-selection preparation. The reported crash occurs in optimizer ScalarEvolution/SCEVExpander/rewriteLoopExitValues, so this pipeline activation cannot directly explain that optimizer crash from the retrieved evidence.

top_candidates.subject: [Clang] support for outputs along indirect edges of asm goto
top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This commit adds support for asm goto outputs on indirect callbr edges. In CodeGenFunction::EmitAsmStmt it records the CallBrInst, splits each indirect destination when outputs exist, materializes callbr result values in the new split blocks, and emits the asm-output stores on every indirect edge as well as the fallthrough path. It adds asm-goto CodeGen coverage showing the new .split blocks and stores.
Changed symbols: CodeGenFunction::EmitAsmStmt; EmitAsmStores; llvm::CallBrInst
Behavioral change: For asm goto with outputs, splits all CallBrInst indirect destinations into synthesized basic blocks.; Creates per-indirect-destination result vectors from the CallBrInst result, using the callbr value directly for one output or extractvalue instructions for multiple outputs.; Emits asm output stores in each synthesized indirect-destination block before branching to the original destination.; Changes asm-goto IR CFG shape by replacing direct indirect destinations with .split blocks when outputs are present.
Assertion or trace link: No retrieved hunk directly touches isKnownSentinel, SCEVExpander, ScalarEvolution, or rewriteLoopExitValues.; Crash-signal reachability is reported as text-unreachable, and the crash assertion artifact is unavailable.
Reproducer link: The issue specifically involves asm goto outputs; this commit directly changes how asm goto output values are represented and stored along indirect edges.; The commit's added tests cover asm goto with output operands and verify that callbr indirect targets are redirected through .split blocks containing output stores.; For a reproducer where an asm-goto indirect edge enters or participates in a pointer loop, these inserted blocks, stores, and changed predecessor/edge structure can materially alter the loop IR later analyzed by optimizer passes.
Pass or subsystem link: Clang CodeGen asm goto lowering; LLVM IR callbr and basic-block/edge construction; Indirect downstream relevance to LLVM loop analysis, ScalarEvolution, SCEVExpander, and loop-exit-value rewriting
Causal explanation: This is a strong source-level match for the asm-goto-output portion of the reproducer and it makes a substantive CFG change: indirect callbr destinations are split and receive result stores. Such a change can alter loop predecessor structure and value availability presented to later optimizer passes, providing a plausible route to the reported SCEVExpander/rewriteLoopExitValues crash. diff --git a/llvm/lib/CodeGen/CallBrPrepare.cpp b/llvm/lib/CodeGen/CallBrPrepare.cpp
new file mode 100644
index 000000000000..4bec56c20eb2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/llvm/lib/CodeGen/CallBrPrepare.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,75 @@
+//===-- CallBrPrepare - Prepare callbr for code generation ----------------===//
+//
+// Part of the LLVM Project, under the Apache License v2.0 with LLVM Exceptions.
+// See https://llvm.org/LICENSE.txt for license information.
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
+//
+//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
+//
+// This pass lowers callbrs in LLVM IR in order to to assist SelectionDAG's
+// codegen.
+//
+// In particular, this pass assists in inserting register copies for the output
+// values of a callbr along the edges leading to the indirect target blocks.
+// Though the output SSA value is defined by the callbr instruction itself in
+// the IR representation, the value cannot be copied to the appropriate virtual
+// registers prior to jumping to an indirect label, since the jump occurs
+// within the user-provided assembly blob.
+//
+// Instead, those copies must occur separately at the beginning of each
+// indirect target. That requires that we create a separate SSA definition in
+// each of them (via llvm.callbr.landingpad), and may require splitting
+// critical edges so we have a location to place the intrinsic. Finally, we
+// remap users of the original callbr output SSA value to instead point to the
+// appropriate llvm.callbr.landingpad value.
+//
+// Ideally, this could be done inside SelectionDAG, or in the
+// MachineInstruction representation, without the use of an IR-level intrinsic.
+// But, within the current framework, it’s simpler to implement as an IR pass.
+// (If support for callbr in GlobalISel is implemented, it’s worth considering
+// whether this is still required.)
+//
+//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
+
+#include "llvm/CodeGen/Passes.h"
+#include "llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h"
+#include "llvm/IR/Function.h"
+#include "llvm/IR/Instructions.h"
+#include "llvm/InitializePasses.h"
+#include "llvm/Pass.h"
+
+using namespace llvm;
+
+#define DEBUG_TYPE "callbrprepare"
+
+namespace {
+
+class CallBrPrepare : public FunctionPass {
+public:
+  CallBrPrepare() : FunctionPass(ID) {}
+  static char ID;
+  void getAnalysisUsage(AnalysisUsage &AU) const override;
+  bool runOnFunction(Function &Fn) override;
+};
+
+} // end anonymous namespace
+
+char CallBrPrepare::ID = 0;
+INITIALIZE_PASS(CallBrPrepare, DEBUG_TYPE, "Prepare callbr", false, false)
+
+FunctionPass *llvm::createCallBrPass() { return new CallBrPrepare(); }
+
+void CallBrPrepare::getAnalysisUsage(AnalysisUsage &AU) const {
+  AU.setPreservesAll();
+}
+
+bool CallBrPrepare::runOnFunction(Function &Fn) {
+  for (BasicBlock &BB : Fn) {
+    auto *CBR = dyn_cast<CallBrInst>(BB.getTerminator());
+    if (!CBR)
+      continue;
+    // TODO: something interesting.
+    // https://discourse.llvm.org/t/rfc-syncing-asm-goto-with-outputs-with-gcc/65453/8
+  }
+  return false;
+}

steps.subject: [llvm] add CallBrPrepare pass to pipelines

evidence: Enables CallBrPrepare for instruction-selection preparation pipelines and changes inlineasm-br verifier behavior.
The mechanism is downstream of the middle-end optimizer, so it has limited ability to explain an SCEVExpander/rewriteLoopExitValues crash during -O1 optimization.
features: asm-goto-outputs, callbr-prepare, isel-pipeline, meta:core-llvm, path:llvm/docs, path:llvm/include/llvm/CodeGen
selection.diff_summary:
Summary: This commit enables the existing CallBrPrepare pass in both new- and legacy-style instruction-selection preparation pipelines, rather than leaving it disabled. It also updates MachineVerifier to allow allocatable live-ins in inlineasm-br indirect-target blocks and adds pipeline tests confirming that callbr preparation runs at O0 and O3 for several targets.
Changed symbols: CodeGenPassBuilder<Derived>::addISelPrepare; TargetPassConfig::addISelPrepare; MachineVerifier::visitMachineBasicBlockBefore; CallBrPrepare
Behavioral change: Schedules CallBrPrepare in the CodeGen IR preparation pipeline through addPass(CallBrPrepare()) and createCallBrPass().; Permits machine basic blocks marked inlineasm-br-indirect-target to have allocatable live-in registers without triggering the prior MachineVerifier diagnostic.; Makes callbr preparation observable in O0 and O3 CodeGen pipeline tests.
Assertion or trace link: No retrieved hunk matches isKnownSentinel, SCEVExpander, ScalarEvolution, or rewriteLoopExitValues.; The modified verifier diagnostic concerns allocatable live-ins in inlineasm-br indirect-target machine blocks, not the reported optimizer assertion/trace.
Reproducer link: CallBrPrepare is directly associated with callbr/asm-goto control-flow representation, so enabling it can change how asm-goto-output IR is prepared before instruction selection.; The retrieved tests are pipeline-presence checks and do not exercise the reported pointer loop or optimizer crash.
Pass or subsystem link: CallBrPrepare; CodeGen instruction-selection preparation; MachineVerifier inlineasm-br target handling
Causal explanation: This is a meaningful asm-goto-related pipeline change: it activates CallBrPrepare for normal CodeGen pipelines and supports its resulting indirect inline-asm target blocks. However, the visible pass insertion is at instruction-selection preparation, whereas the reported failure is attributed to ScalarEvolution/SCEVExpander loop-exit rewriting in the optimizer. The retrieved evidence establishes callbr relevance but does not establish that CallBrPrepare runs before, invokes, or alters the failing SCEV path.
Causal confidence: 0.14
Build risk: Changes both modern CodeGenPassBuilder and legacy TargetPassConfig pipeline construction.; Adds O0/O3 pipeline expectations for AArch64, PowerPC, and RISCV.; MachineVerifier acceptance criteria are broadened for inlineasm-br indirect-target blocks.; Thirty-nine hunks were omitted from retrieval, so only the shown pipeline/verifier effects are assessed.; No crash assertion artifact was available for direct stack or assertion matching.

Summary: This commit is an explicitly NFC refactor of CodeGenFunction::EmitAsmStmt. It extracts the existing inline-assembly output conversion, boolean-assumption, destination-cast, and store sequence into a new EmitAsmStores helper, while retaining the same UpdateAsmCallInst calls and changing only minor formatting and reference/cast expression structure.
Changed symbols: CodeGenFunction::EmitAsmStmt; EmitAsmStores; UpdateAsmCallInst
Behavioral change: Moves existing asm output-result processing from CodeGenFunction::EmitAsmStmt into the new static EmitAsmStores helper.; Preserves the prior output conversion and storage logic, including flag-register llvm.assume generation, pointer/integer conversions, scalarizable operand stores, and diagnostic handling.; Removes redundant explicit cast<llvm::CallBase> expressions at two UpdateAsmCallInst call sites.
Assertion or trace link: No retrieved hunk references isKnownSentinel, SCEVExpander, ScalarEvolution, rewriteLoopExitValues, or loop-exit rewriting.; The commit is labeled NFC and the visible changes are a code-motion refactor rather than a changed optimizer invariant.
Reproducer link: The refactored routine emits inline-asm outputs, which is generally related to asm goto outputs.; No visible change is specific to asm goto control-flow, pointer loops, or the reduced crashing optimization case.
Pass or subsystem link: Clang CodeGen inline-assembly emission; CodeGenFunction::EmitAsmStmt
Causal explanation: Although this touches the relevant Clang asm-emission subsystem, the retrieved diff retains the prior logic and merely delegates it to EmitAsmStores. It neither changes ScalarEvolution nor loop canonicalization/exit-value rewriting, and it provides no evidence of a semantic change capable of introducing the reported SCEVExpander crash. The direct causal case is therefore very weak.
Causal confidence: 0.02

top_candidates.subject: [Clang] support for outputs along indirect edges of asm goto
top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This commit implements asm goto output propagation along indirect callbr edges in CodeGenFunction::EmitAsmStmt. For asm goto statements with outputs, it splits every indirect destination, extracts callbr return values into per-successor result vectors, stores those outputs in the synthetic edge blocks, and then branches to the original label. It adds code-generation tests that check the resulting split blocks, extractvalue instructions, and stores.
Changed symbols: CodeGenFunction::EmitAsmStmt; llvm::CallBrInst; EmitAsmStores; clang/test/CodeGen/asm-goto2.c; clang/test/CodeGen/asm-goto.c
Behavioral change: Changes asm goto with outputs from using direct indirect destinations to routing each indirect edge through a newly created '<destination>.split' basic block.; For single-output callbr, propagates the callbr value directly; for multi-output callbr, emits extractvalue instructions for each result.; Calls EmitAsmStores in each synthetic indirect-edge block so asm outputs are materialized on indirect asm goto paths as well as the fallthrough path.; Mutates CallBrInst indirect destinations with setIndirectDest to target the synthetic blocks.
Reproducer link: The issue reproducer specifically uses asm goto outputs, and this commit directly changes lowering for asm goto statements with outputs.; The new lowering creates additional basic blocks, branches, output stores, and callbr result extractions on indirect edges; such CFG changes can alter the loop and exit-value shape subsequently presented to -O1 loop passes.; The added tests explicitly verify asm goto output stores on both fallthrough and indirect-label paths, including a test where an indirect destination is a loop label.
Pass or subsystem link: Clang CodeGen asm goto/callbr lowering; LLVM optimizer loop CFG and exit-value consumers; ScalarEvolution/SCEVExpander only indirectly, through the changed IR CFG and values
Causal explanation: This is a strong semantic match for the asm goto outputs portion of the reproducer. By introducing synthetic edge blocks and placing output stores and extracted callbr values on paths that may enter or exit loops, it can materially change loop canonicalization and the values considered by downstream exit-value rewriting. The retrieved evidence does not show a direct modification of ScalarEvolution, SCEVExpander, isKnownSentinel, or rewriteLoopExitValues, and the crash assertion artifact is unavailable, so the link to the exact crash remains indirect rather than proven.
Causal confidence: 0.72
Build risk: Adds llvm/ADT/DenseMap.h and uses a DenseMap keyed by BasicBlock pointers for per-edge asm results.; Introduces CFG mutation through CallBrInst::setIndirectDest and insertion-point manipulation, increasing IR-validity and control-flow-sensitive risk.; Adds substantial O0 Clang CodeGen FileCheck coverage for single and multi-output asm goto cases.; Visible tests validate generated IR structure but do not exercise -O1 optimization, ScalarEvolution, SCEVExpander, or loop-exit rewriting.
